object_description: polygonal workshop volume on a terraced base
design_condition: The prominent workshop volume and lower base are separated by a clear gap and placed across the slope to connect different campus levels, broaden the spatial setting, and expose nearby residential buildings.

positive.statement: The clear distribution of uses and spatial separation allow the existing main building to remain independent while giving the new building a self-confident presence.
The clear gap between the buildings makes the campus appear wider and more open.
The polygonal volumetry shows astonishing precision, skilfully avoids building lines, and achieves well-proportioned building lengths.
The base building is cleverly placed in the topography and connects the different campus levels at the center.
Common uses at this interface generate the greatest publicity across the campus.
The informal gaming opportunities are well located.
The urban-planning concept and sophisticated distribution of uses create a system of high local architectural quality.

negative.statement: The formal design of the terrace appears arbitrary, without context, and does not achieve the qualities of its references.
The tree and design concept appears weak and random, and the poor ratio between hard and green spaces is hardly conducive to biodiversity.
The workshop layout calls efficient organization into question, significantly undercuts the required spatial program, and creates difficult lighting conditions in some zones.
The inner support structure appears inflexible and sometimes obstructive at the edges.
The effectiveness of the massive facade as active sun protection is highly questionable.
The monumentality and gravity of the expression do not indicate the technical and didactic content of the institution.
The programmatic omissions require space-intensive adjustments in delivery and building services.
The escape routes would require additional access cores.
